info.name: Microservices – Lab 7 (API Gateway & Cloud)
info.description: Postman Collection for Web Services & SOA Lab 7: API Gateway, Configuration-Based Service Discovery & Cloud Deployment. All requests are routed exclusively through the API Gateway single public entry point.

variable.description: Public Cloud Gateway URL (use 'http://localhost:8000' for local Docker Compose testing)

item.name: 1. API Gateway Health & Routing Table
GET /health (Gateway Health Check & Service Registry)

request.description: Reports API Gateway status, runtime port, configuration-based service discovery registry, and path routing table without proxying.

item.name: GET / (Gateway Root Discovery)

request.description: Root entry point providing gateway metadata, health check link, and service route directory.

item.name: 2. Gateway-Routed User Service (/users)
GET All Users via Gateway

request.description: Routes GET /users through API Gateway to User Service.

item.name: GET User by ID via Gateway (101)

request.description: Routes GET /users/101 through API Gateway to User Service.

item.name: POST Create User via Gateway

request.description: Routes POST /users through API Gateway with JSON body to create a new user.

item.name: PUT Update User via Gateway (101)

request.description: Routes PUT /users/101 through API Gateway to update user details.

item.name: DELETE User by ID via Gateway (105)

request.description: Routes DELETE /users/105 through API Gateway to delete the specified user.

item.name: 3. Gateway-Routed Product Service (/products)
GET All Products via Gateway

request.description: Routes GET /products through API Gateway to Product Service.

item.name: GET Product by ID via Gateway (501)

request.description: Routes GET /products/501 through API Gateway to Product Service.

item.name: POST Create Product via Gateway

body.raw:

  "id": "505",
  "name": "Digital Oscilloscope Probe Kit",

request.description: Routes POST /products through API Gateway to create a new catalog product.

item.name: PUT Update Product via Gateway (501)

request.description: Routes PUT /products/501 through API Gateway to update price and stock.

item.name: DELETE Product by ID via Gateway (505)

request.description: Routes DELETE /products/505 through API Gateway to remove the product.

item.name: 4. Gateway-Routed Order Service (/orders)
GET All Orders via Gateway

request.description: Routes GET /orders through API Gateway to Order Service.

item.name: GET Order by ID via Gateway

request.description: Routes GET /orders/{id} through API Gateway to fetch a specific order.

item.name: POST Create Valid Order via Gateway [201 Expected]

request.description: Routes POST /orders through API Gateway to Order Service, validating User and Product downstream.

item.name: POST Create Order with Invalid User [404 Expected]

request.description: Routes POST /orders through API Gateway where downstream Order Service validates that User 999 does not exist.

item.name: 5. Gateway Failure Test & Centralized Error Handling
Failure Test Step 1 & 2 - Normal State: GET /users/101 [200 OK]

request.description: Exercise Step 2: Start all services and confirm normal 200 OK response through the gateway.

item.name: Failure Test Step 3, 4 & 5 - Downstream Stopped: GET /users/101 [502/503 Expected]

request.description: Exercise Step 4 & 5: After stopping user-service container ('docker stop user-service'), gateway catches downstream network disconnect and returns clean 502/503 without crashing or hanging.

item.name: Cloud Live Verification: GET /products [502 Bad Gateway Expected]

request.description: On Render Cloud deployment where product-service is set to internal localhost:3002 (offline), verifies centralized 502 Bad Gateway error handling live over the internet.

item.name: Failure Test Step 6 - Recovery: GET /users/101 [200 OK Restored]

request.description: Exercise Step 6: Restart User Service ('docker start user-service') and repeat request to confirm full system recovery.

item.name: Gateway 404 Route Not Found: GET /unregistered-service [404 Expected]

request.description: Verifies that an unregistered path returns a clear gateway 404 JSON response listing valid routes.
